title: Add Workspaces rail section and migrate saved section order
outcome: Owner Termal::Grok. Add workspaces to ControlPanelSectionId, section definition/icon in ui/src/panels/ControlPanelSurface.tsx. Standard rail focus/active/tooltip styling; outlined layout icon distinct from Projects/Files. Default order puts Workspaces immediately above Projects. Existing order key termal-control-panel-section-order-v2 currently appends missing sections: fix normalization so a missing Workspaces is inserted immediately before normalized Projects, retaining order of every existing section. If Workspaces already exists, honor its user-chosen position; handle duplicates/unknown entries and repeated normalization idempotently, no storage reset. Workspaces has no launcher WorkspaceTab in v1: createControlPanelSectionLauncherTab returns null for it, internal rail reorder works, no misleading drag-to-open affordance and no new persisted tab kind. Tests default/old reordered order/invalid order/reload/custom move, activation and existing sections unaffected. Observe fixedSection control surfaces remain restricted to their own section.
